name: verified-email
summary: One person's work email, found and then checked, in one call. Give a LinkedIn URL or a name and a domain. Provider calls at cost, plus $0.01 only when the email is valid or risky.

linkedin_url.note: the person's LinkedIn profile; the best identity when you have it

full_name.note: with domain, when you have no LinkedIn URL

domain.note: the company's website domain; needed with a name
